evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label and adds the AssertUnreachable() macro to src/util/check.h.
rationale: Introduces AssertUnreachable() to eliminate compiler warnings and provide a safe alternative to std::unreachable(). As the description notes, 'assert(false) create ambiguity over NDEBUG semantics and cause clang-cl warnings, while Assert(false) obscures the noreturn attribute... and triggers GCC return-type warnings.' Providing a clear, aborting assertion primitive simplifies unreachable code paths across the entire codebase.
